educationalGoal: The objective of this course is to develop a basic ability to design, manufacture, and make feasible proposals for aircraft design, the application of aeronautical engineering theory, and the evaluation of actual phenomena related to aircraft.
advice:
Specific project themes will be determined through discussion, and problems will be discovered and resolved according to these discussions. Themes can be broadly classified as follows.

(1) Research on reentry technique
(2) Research on aircraft for planetary exploration
(3) Research on a flexible wing

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Explain the purpose of the project theme and the process, and achieve annual goals that are suitable for the purpose.
(2) Summarize as an interim report, and present and discuss the report. Summarize as a project report and present and discuss in a public presentation review meeting. The final results can be published as an academic paper and receive an external evaluation.
(3) Design and manufacture experimental equipment, and evaluate the performance of the product.

              The objective of this course is to develop a basic ability to design, manufacture, and make feasible proposals for aircraft design, the application of aeronautical engineering theory, and the evaluation of actual phenomena related to aircraft.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              Specific project themes will be determined through discussion, and problems will be discovered and resolved according to these discussions. Themes can be broadly classified as follows.

(1) Research on reentry technique
(2) Research on aircraft for planetary exploration
(3) Research on a flexible wing
